description: This PHP source file contains functions related to CSV import and export, specifically for a test management system called TestLink. It includes functions to export data to CSV format and import CSV data into the system, along with associated options and handling logic.

methods.name: exportDataToCSV
methods.description: Exports given data to a CSV formatted string, with optional header row and delimiter customization.

methods.name: importCSVData
methods.description: Reads CSV data from a file, maps fields according to provided mappings, and returns structured data along with parsing statistics and errors.
